_comment: Shared by the PHP recorder (tests/Contract) and the Go replay (api/contract). A value matching a rule is replaced by its placeholder in fixtures and in live responses before comparing.

url._comment: Absolute URLs: scheme and host become <url>, the path is kept so storage paths are still compared. Relative paths matching path_regex keep their shape too. In both, path segments that are random file names (Str::random, uniqid) become <file>.
